me.availability: Open to Senior Frontend roles · remote or hybrid

ui.statement: I turn complicated products into interfaces people actually enjoy using. Ten years of React, two products of my own, and an unhealthy obsession with the last ten percent.
ui.aboutP1: I started coding in 2001 and never stopped. Today I’m a senior frontend engineer — React, TypeScript, component architecture, state, performance and accessibility — with enough backend and infra in my hands to ship whole products.
ui.aboutP2: I run a small studio, Vue d’Esprit, co-founded Kaast (4,000+ users) and I’m building Synqit on the side. Off-screen: paragliding, skating, woodworking, and presiding a school nonprofit.

synqit.tagline: One magic link. Every streaming service. Everyone's songs.
synqit.summary: Collaborative event playlists and cross-service playlist sync. Hosts share a single magic link; guests add tracks without signing up, from Spotify, Apple Music, TIDAL, YouTube Music and more.
synqit.challenge: Make five music APIs with different catalogues, quotas and auth models feel like one product — with zero friction for guests who just want to add a song.

built.title: Guest magic-link flow
built.body: Revocable, regenerable event links; guests search and add tracks, duplicates rejected, any provider can host through one adapter registry.

built.title: Sync & transfer engine
built.body: Adaptive back-off scheduler, snapshot/manifest change detection, ISRC-first matching and per-track checkpoints so quota hits resume instead of restart.

built.title: Billing that can't drift
built.body: Stripe Checkout on web, Payment Sheet on mobile, grants only through idempotent webhooks, 402 paywalls driven by one shared plan table.

built.title: Back office & analytics
built.body: Mantine console with Sankey path flows and a live heat overlay, analytics minimised to CNIL guidance.

layers.label: Clients
layers.value: React web app · Expo iOS/Android · Mantine back office

layers.label: API
layers.value: Fastify modular monolith, cookie sessions + CSRF

layers.label: Workers
layers.value: BullMQ on Redis — sync, transfer, imports

layers.label: Providers
layers.value: Spotify · Apple Music · TIDAL · YouTube · Deezer

kaast.tagline: Internal media, streamed like a premium platform.
kaast.summary: Multi-tenant internal media communication platform used by 5 client companies and 4,000+ users, with a strong focus on frontend product quality, navigation, search and shared UI consistency across tenant-specific needs.
kaast.challenge: One codebase, many brands: every tenant wants their own look and flows, while the product has to stay consistent, fast and maintainable by a two-person team.

built.title: Frontend architecture
built.body: Led the multi-tenant React platform — page composition, navigation flows and the overall interaction model.

built.title: Shared component system
built.body: A component library supporting tenant-specific customisation while keeping one consistent product experience.

built.title: Search & routing
built.body: TanStack Router, Meilisearch and structured navigation for series, seasons, shorts and playlists.

built.title: Customer-driven delivery
built.body: Two-person Kanban team pushing features within tight audit periods, translating stakeholder needs into intuitive UX.

layers.label: Frontend
layers.value: React product interface for internal communication workflows

layers.label: UI System
layers.value: Component library, SCSS, Tailwind, Cloudflare-facing integrations

layers.label: Search & Routing
layers.value: TanStack Router, Meilisearch and structured navigation flows

layers.label: State & Data
layers.value: TanStack Query, cache & state management, connected API flows

horizon-planning.tagline: The weekly crew plan, finally out of the spreadsheet.
horizon-planning.summary: Weekly crew-planning SaaS for building and renovation companies. Started as an internal tool for a Savoie renovation firm, grown into a multi-tenant product with self-serve signup and plans.
horizon-planning.challenge: Replace a fragile spreadsheet that ran a whole company's week — without slowing down the people who fill it in every morning on site.

built.title: Planning grid
built.body: Employees × slots × days with autosave; travel allowances computed per zone via haversine distance and BAN geocoding.

built.title: Real multi-tenancy
built.body: org_id on every table, per-request transaction scoping, pgTAP isolation tests, per-tenant branding and custom domains.

built.title: Access & audit
built.body: Custom profiles with per-page permissions, anti-escalation guard, full audit log, zxcvbn and a strict CSP.

built.title: Timesheets & PWA
built.body: Monthly hours, meals and absences with CSV and A4 print; installable PWA with guided onboarding.

layers.label: Ops
layers.value: OVH VPS, Caddy, split prod/staging, encrypted nightly backups

comacademy.tagline: Learn communication & marketing, five minutes a day.
comacademy.summary: Freemium iOS & Android app teaching communication and marketing — dictionary, job profiles, quizzes, a content feed and weekly challenges — with a Strapi backend and a 30-page back office.
comacademy.challenge: Keep daily learners coming back: fair weekly challenges for people who join mid-week, premium content that converts, and store-compliant payments on both platforms.

built.title: Weekly challenge engine
built.body: Five daily challenges per week counted from each user's own start, missed days unlocked for mid-week joiners, bonus on completion.

built.title: In-app purchases
built.body: react-native-iap with receipts stored in Strapi and a mock service so the app runs in Expo Go.

built.title: Feed & engagement
built.body: Snapshot-and-recycle feed engine, likes, quiz game, trophies, favourites and playlists.

built.title: Back office
built.body: ~30 React pages for content, users, analytics and push-notification templates.

layers.label: App
layers.value: Expo / React Native on iOS + Android

layers.label: Distribution
layers.value: App Store + Google Play via EAS

asba.tagline: Handmade French drums, a site as loud as the kits.
asba.summary: Showcase site, catalogue and custom back office for ASBA, a French maker of handmade drums — products, finishes, artists, resellers map and a lead-tracking mini-CRM.
asba.challenge: Give a small craft brand a premium, editorial presence and a back office simple enough that updates never break the design.

built.title: Product catalogue
built.body: Custom Strapi endpoint serving specs, finish swatches and galleries, filtered and paginated.

built.title: Built-in back office
built.body: Manage pages, products, artists, finishes, manifesto and legal pages from inside the React app.

built.title: Leads & monitoring
built.body: Prospect tracking feeding an internal CRM, plus a service monitor on public routes.

built.title: Hardened ops
built.body: SSH-keys-only OVH server with UFW & Fail2ban, frontend on Vercel, yearly maintenance contract.

maison-du-print.tagline: A screen-printing workshop with a website as hands-on as the ink.
maison-du-print.summary: Bilingual FR/EN website for an independent screen-printing and DTF textile workshop in Isère — services, quotes and a gallery of client work, with content managed through Sanity and a custom admin.
maison-du-print.challenge: Let the workshop compare four visual directions live before committing, then keep editing texts and the gallery themselves — without handing them a heavy CMS interface.

built.title: Four designs, one codebase
built.body: V1–V4 shipped side by side behind a version bar; the dark V4 lives on the same URLs and old links redirect cleanly.

built.title: Sanity through the API
built.body: Texts, media and gallery works are read through serverless functions; a migration script pushed the local content into Sanity.

built.title: A custom admin
built.body: Texts, media and drag-and-drop gallery ordering, secured with HMAC-signed HttpOnly session cookies — no auth library.

built.title: Mobile Safari polish
built.body: Dynamic Island safe areas, scroll locking, a workaround for iOS not re-evaluating :has(), auto-reload of stale tabs after a deploy, sharp-optimised gallery images.

np-ebenisterie.tagline: Furniture that belongs to the space — built by hand, shipped in Angular.
np-ebenisterie.summary: Bilingual portfolio for my own bespoke furniture and woodworking workshop around Lyon: river tables, fitted entryways, desks and small objects, each piece documented as a case study.
np-ebenisterie.challenge: Show woodwork the way it feels in person — grain, light, scale — while keeping the site static, fast and nearly free to run until a CMS is worth it.

built.title: Angular 20, zoneless
built.body: Standalone components, signals and zoneless change detection with strict template checks; native CSS, no component library.

built.title: Furniture case studies
built.body: Typed bilingual project content with process steps and galleries, plus a side-projects shelf for cutting boards and experiments.

built.title: Accessible motion
built.body: A reusable IntersectionObserver scroll-reveal directive that stays still for people who prefer reduced motion.

built.title: Brand & print
built.body: The hexagon mark carried from the website to wood-grain business cards; a documented Sanity + protected-form plan for the next step.

soulbm.tagline: A nonprofit run like a startup.
soulbm.summary: Public website and a full operations back office for the school parents' association I preside — treasury, events, inventory, tasks, registrations and audit logs.
soulbm.challenge: Volunteers rotate every year. The tools have to be obvious on day one and keep the money trail clean without an accountant in the room.

built.title: Operations back office
built.body: 30+ content types: treasury, expense splits per class, tasks, events, temporary inventories, roles and audit logs.

built.title: Receipt scanning with Claude
built.body: Snap a receipt on an iPhone, HEIC converted server-side, line items extracted into inventory.

built.title: Analytics app
built.body: Separate dashboard for page views, errors and admin activity alongside PostHog.

built.title: Self-hosted & hardened
built.body: Strapi 5 on Postgres 16 behind Nginx/PM2 with Let's Encrypt, UFW and Fail2ban.

ab2c.tagline: Drawn, not ruled — an agricultural brand with a pencil.
ab2c.summary: Web presence, showcase site and upcoming catalogue for AB2C, exclusive MICROFERM distributor for France, Belgium, Luxembourg and Switzerland.
ab2c.challenge: Make a technical agri-measurement distributor feel human and trustworthy, and ship it in four paid phases without rewriting between them.

built.title: Hand-drawn design system
built.body: Frames and separators are generated pencil lines and sketched SVGs instead of borders and shadows.

built.title: CMS-ready content
built.body: Typed content package that swaps to Payload CMS 3 without touching the UI.

built.title: Serious forms
built.body: Server functions with Zod, Turnstile, Resend and a CRM hook.

fournelles.summary: Website and order flow for a Brouilly wine estate — rebuilt from a 2022 PHP site into React with a secure admin for wines, labels and orders.
fournelles.challenge: Let a family estate update wines and take orders themselves, without ever exposing a service key to the browser.

built.title: Wines in Supabase
built.body: RLS-protected table with public read, JSON seed doubling as offline fallback.

built.title: Locked-down admin
built.body: Supabase Auth + email allowlist, all writes through Vercel functions.

built.title: Order flow
built.body: Request and confirmation emails via Resend, bottle & label uploads to Storage.

careledger.tagline: Maintenance contracts, hours and infra — one ledger.
careledger.summary: Local-first tracker for my freelance maintenance contracts: allowances, time logs, and a per-client dossier covering infrastructure, costs, decisions and deploy flow.
careledger.challenge: Know at a glance which client is over their hours, what their stack costs per month, and how to deploy it — without a SaaS subscription.

built.title: Contract buckets
built.body: Monthly to whole-contract periods; included hours, features, security and no-charge work.

built.title: Timer that survives
built.body: Task timer persists across restarts, soft deletes, timestamped edit history.

built.title: Project dossiers
built.body: Infra, run-rate costs, phases, decisions, deploy flow diagrams and a map — secrets refused by design.

Built the frontend product experience in parallel with the backend logic that powers playlist import and cross-service sharing, with particular attention to onboarding flows, user retention, and reducing friction throughout the user journey.

Handled end-to-end delivery from discovery and data modeling to frontend implementation and deployment.
Focused on clear UX, maintainable code, and backend structures that stayed practical for long-term client operations.

history.title: Frontend Developer
history.body: SaaS dashboard for network deployment workflows — joined at proof of concept, helped ship a customer-facing MVP and V1.
points: Built and evolved React interfaces for infrastructure and deployment operations, turning complex technical workflows into clear, maintainable SaaS product experiences.

Worked as one of two frontend developers in a 10-person product team (4 backend, 2 SRE, 1 PO, 1 PM), in a fast-paced agile environment with real-time events, search tooling, and supporting Node-based tooling to keep operational data accurate across the product lifecycle.

history.title: Technical Support & Product Testing

points: Resolved technical issues with a structured, user-focused approach.
Contributed to product testing and quality feedback loops.
Strengthened communication and problem-solving in high-volume contexts.
